card_statuses.ask: Which elite statuses or memberships does {name} confer, or allow enrollment in? Record enrollment steps and whether the status ends with the card.

combined_with.ask: Is there any benefit, offer or stacking opportunity that requires or rewards holding both {a} and {b}?

identify.ask: What is {name}? Which program does it belong to, and does it connect to any program already in the knowledge base?

inbound_paths.ask: Apart from earning it directly, what routes lead to {name} (matches, challenges, cards, partner tiers, transfers)?

partner_benefits.ask: What does {name} unlock outside its own program (lounges, car rental, cruise, casino, rail, retail, partner earning or redemption)?

status_match_out.ask: Which other loyalty programs give a status, a status match or a status challenge to holders of {name}? Record eligibility, required linking or registration, how long the result lasts, and what happens if {name} is later lost.

transfer_out.ask: Which programs can {name} be transferred or converted to, at what ratio, with what minimums, limits and transfer time?
